mapper.select: SELECT l.sku_id AS c0, COALESCE(SUM(l.quantity), 0) AS c1 FROM device_sku_lot l WHERE l.device_id = #{deviceId} AND l.status IN ('ON_SALE', 'NEAR_EXPIRY') AND l.quantity > 0 GROUP BY l.sku_id

SELECT l.sku_id AS c0, COALESCE(SUM(l.quantity), 0) AS c1 FROM device_sku_lot l LEFT JOIN device_slot s ON s.device_id = l.device_id AND UPPER(s.slot_code) = UPPER(l.slot_id) WHERE l.device_id = #{deviceId} AND l.status IN ('ON_SALE', 'NEAR_EXPIRY') AND l.quantity > 0 AND COALESCE(s.enabled, true) = true GROUP BY l.sku_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM device_sku_lot l WHERE l.status IN ('ON_SALE', 'NEAR_EXPIRY', 'BLOCKED') AND l.quantity > 0 AND l.expiry_date < #{today}
SELECT l.slot_id AS c0, COALESCE(SUM(l.quantity), 0) AS c1 FROM device_sku_lot l WHERE l.device_id = #{deviceId} AND l.slot_id IS NOT NULL AND l.slot_id <> '' AND l.quantity > 0 GROUP BY l.slot_id
